newsitem.title: USA: Motorola wins cellular contract in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Motorola wins cellular contract in Brazil.

text.p: Motorola Inc said its Pan American Wireless Infrastructure division signed a $7.5 million contract to provide a cellular telephone network in Brazil.
Telecomunicacoes do Ceara S.A. will use Motorola's Advanced Mobile Phone Service network to serve more than 13,000 subscribers in the state of Ceara.
As part of the contract, Motorola will install its large-capacity EMX 2500 mobile switch and its ThinCell base stations.
Telecomunicacoes do Ceara currently has 120,000 cellular subscribers. By 2001, it expects to have nearly 250,000 cellular and more than 980,000 fixed accesses.
